title: Separate normal-production window smoke from fixture visual verification

scope.claim: Normal Release Overview and Map Data presentation using production service composition with passive owner-evidence safety; fixture visual proof remains separately owned by R7-134.
notClaimed: No live game launch or gameplay action.
No human click-through of the final end-to-end workflow.
No replacement for R7-134 fixture/browser/pixel validation.

harness.presentationIsolation: Existing WebView Presentation directory is moved atomically to a unique temporary path before launch; a fresh Presentation directory is used; the temporary directory is deleted and the original directory restored in finally.
harness.configProtection: config.json and config.backup.json SHA-256 values must remain unchanged.
harness.processSafety: Refuses to run if LWBridge.Desktop, LastWar, or LastWarLauncher is already active; fails if LastWar, launcher, or Overview helper appears.
harness.successPublication: The result file is written only after temporary Presentation/evidence cleanup and original Presentation restoration complete successfully.

release.hashDifferenceReason: The .NET SDK embeds Git SourceRevisionId in AssemblyInformationalVersion when building inside a Git worktree. The index-only validation snapshot intentionally has no .git metadata; application source is identical.

mapData.readOnlyObservation: A real saved City search/render path executed under normal production composition and rendered a correlated empty-state table.

defectFoundAndRepaired.defect: A staged validation run closed both LWBridge windows successfully but WebView2 still held Presentation/EBWebView/lockfile briefly, causing immediate temporary-profile deletion to fail before the original Presentation directory was restored.
defectFoundAndRepaired.recovery: The existing 386-file/41,490,264-byte Presentation profile was confirmed in the unique temporary backup, the fresh 4-file temporary profile was removed after the lock released, and the original profile was restored before continuing.
defectFoundAndRepaired.repair: Temporary directory removal now retries for up to 20 seconds after WebView shutdown. The checker delays result publication until cleanup/restoration has completed, so cleanup failure cannot leave a success artifact.
defectFoundAndRepaired.forceKillPolicy: No WebView2/game/launcher process is force-killed to make cleanup pass.

fixtureVisualSeparation.note: R7-135 does not reuse fixture mode as production evidence; R7-134 remains the separate fixture/browser/pixel gate.

conclusion: R10 production-mode versus fixture-mode verification is separately evidenced and current. The final human built-executable end-to-end walkthrough remains open.
